description: Save web pages to Cubox for later reading and processing.

fields.label: API URL
fields.description: The personal API URL copied from Cubox under Preferences > Extensions and Automation > API Extension. Keep this URL secret: https://help.cubox.pro/save/89d3/.

actions.name: save_url
actions.description: Save a web page to Cubox for queued parsing and snapshot processing.

url.description: The web page URL to save.

title.description: Optional title for the saved page.

description.description: Optional description for the saved page.

tags.description: Optional Cubox tags to apply to the saved page.

folder.description: Optional Cubox folder name for the saved page.

inputSchema.description: The web page and optional metadata to save to Cubox.

queued.description: Whether Cubox accepted the page for queued parsing and snapshot processing.
